lines.2: Otome's fingers wedged themselves into the gap in the door.
lines.4: Now I knew how the protagonist in a horror story felt.
lines.5: She forced the door open from the hallway with incredible strength.
lines.10: 「Y-You followed me into my room! This is a violation of my human rights!」
lines.11: 「Hah. And? Do not underestimate an athlete. Besides, getting my fingers caught just now hurt!」
lines.12: She twisted my arm tighter and tighter.
lines.14: 「I dislike how you think running away will solve everything. You spineless fool!」
